notes.title: Legacy data migration runbook
notes.body:
Owner: platform team
Status: in review
We migrate the legacy notes into the new schema before the release freeze.
Rollback keeps the old table for one week.
Contact the on-call engineer if the row count differs.

notes.title: 上线部署流程
notes.body:
负责人：后端
部署前先执行远程 migration，再触发构建。
构建成功后确认健康检查返回 200。
如果健康检查失败就回滚到上一个版本。

notes.title: Device pairing notes
notes.body:
The pairing code expires after ten minutes and can only be used once.
Generate a new code from the settings dialog on a device that is already connected.
Revoke a lost device from another paired device.

notes.title: 回收站与保留期
notes.body:
删除的笔记会在回收站保留三十天，超期后彻底清除。
清理任务由定时触发器执行。
目前恢复入口只有接口，没有界面。

notes.title: Vector index maintenance
notes.body:
The vector index stores one embedding per note line.
Rebuild the index whenever the embedding model changes.
A lower vector count than the database row count means recall coverage is broken.

notes.title: 快捷键说明
notes.body:
全局唤起使用 Command + Shift + Space。
上下方向键在结果之间移动，回车打开笔记。
按下 Tab 会复制命中行并进入行内编辑。

notes.title: Image storage design
notes.body:
Image bytes live in a private object storage bucket.
Signed image URLs expire after twenty four hours.
The signing key is generated once and stored in the database.

notes.title: 设备认证与令牌
notes.body:
设备令牌是高熵随机值，数据库只保存它的哈希。
会话默认有效期一百八十天。
吊销设备会同时失效它的会话和未使用的配对码。

notes.title: 手机端使用方式
notes.body:
手机不需要安装应用商店里的程序。
在 Safari 里选择添加到主屏幕，就能像独立应用一样打开。
离线时只能看到已经加载过的内容。

notes.title: Lost device checklist
notes.body:
Open the device list from a machine you still control.
Delete the missing device so its sessions are revoked immediately.
Rotate the pairing code afterwards and tell the team.

notes.title: 推理成本控制
notes.body:
把重复查询的向量缓存起来可以显著降低推理开销。
批量请求比逐条请求便宜。
只在精确搜索没有结果时才调用语义搜索。

notes.title: Database export plan
notes.body:
Export the notes table every week.
Keep three generations of exports.
Verify a restore into a scratch database every quarter.

notes.title: 常用命令
notes.body:
本地迁移：wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
远程迁移：wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
部署：wrangler deploy
干跑校验：wrangler deploy --dry-run

notes.title: Worker configuration keys
notes.body:
SEMANTIC_MIN_COSINE defaults to 0.5
SEMANTIC_CHUNK_TOP_K defaults to 40
TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS defaults to 30
SESSION_TTL_DAYS defaults to 180

notes.title: Model pricing
notes.body:
Text embeddings cost $0.012 per million input tokens.
Translation costs $0.34 per million tokens.
The budget alert triggers at fifty dollars per month.

notes.title: 运维手册
notes.body:
本手册记录日常运维动作。
每天检查健康接口是否返回 200。
每天查看构建历史是否有失败记录。
每周确认队列没有堆积。
每周查看错误日志的前十条。
关注请求延迟的九十五分位。
关注推理调用次数的日环比。
数据库空间超过八成需要告警。
对象存储的孤儿文件每天清理一次。
如果向量数量少于数据库记录数，就重新排队所有笔记重建索引。
定时任务失败要人工重跑一次。
配对码过期记录保留一天。
会话过期记录立即清除。
限流窗口过期即清除。
图片上传超过十二兆会被拒绝。
笔记正文上限是两百万字符。
标题上限是五百字符。
每次发布都要记录构建号。
回滚要保留失败版本的日志。
值班同学负责跟进告警。

notes.title: Security review notes
notes.body:
This note tracks open security questions.
Device tokens are opaque high entropy values.
Only hashes of tokens are stored.
Sessions expire after one hundred and eighty days.
Setup uses a trust on first use window.
The first claim must happen immediately after deployment.
Rate limits are keyed by a hash of the client address.
Raw client addresses are never persisted.
Rotate the image signing key if a signed URL ever leaks.
Audit the device list after every team change.
The worker sees plaintext during inference.
This is not zero knowledge encryption.
Backups inherit the same trust boundary.
Third party analytics are not used.
The admin surface is limited to the deployment account.
Operator diagnostics must not return note text by default.
Public releases must disable operator diagnostics.
Security questions are reviewed every quarter.

notes.title: 发布检查清单
notes.body:
发布前确认版本号已经更新。
确认变更记录写清楚了影响范围。
确认回滚方案有人复核。
发布后在群里同步结果。

notes.title: Setup page copy
notes.body:
The setup page explains the first claim.
It links to the deployment guide.
It reminds the operator to bookmark the worker address.
It does not expose any secret value.

notes.title: 搜索交互备忘
notes.body:
搜索框第一项永远是快速创建。
命中行使用彩虹高亮。
结果卡片保持平铺不折叠。
滚动时命中行要自动对齐到阅读位置。

notes.body:

每人自己打包显示器和键盘。
搬迁公司下午两点到。
迁移当天不安排会议。

notes.body:

第三天二条城，晚上锦市场。

notes.body:

加热水小火炖四十分钟收汁。
